title: Sunday · the Rain, 2019
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-second January. The garage sill. Three jars. Lamp on, lamp off. The pup in the bed. The Empty Chair's framing with everything in it alive.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the sill. Three jars. Rain in resist. The alley a blur.

image.prompt: a casement window from inside a garage studio with rain in watercolor resist, three jars on the sill with brushes, nibs and a sand dollar, no figures

panels.name: Sill

panels.composition: Tier 2: the table, the lamp on, the chair empty, the bed beneath with the three-legged dog in it, awake, watching the window.

image.prompt: a drafting table under a rainy window with the lamp on and chair empty, a three-legged dog awake in a braided bed beneath watching the window, watercolor

panels.name: Awake

panels.composition: Tier 3: lamp off, blue light. The dog asleep. Held.

image.prompt: the same table with the lamp off in cold blue rain-light, the dog asleep beneath, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Blue

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust
